title: LiteLLM key_management_endpoints Missing Authorization Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass security features on affected installations of LiteLLM. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the key_management_endpoints module. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges to resources normally protected from the user.
addtionnal_details:
LiteLLM has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.104.0
timeline:
